subject: Pipeline buffer assessment & mitigation plan — Q2
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-05T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pipeline buffer assessment & mitigation plan — Q2

Team —

Quick heads-up as Finance locked the preliminary Q2 forecast this morning: our pipe-to-quota buffer in US mid-market shows a 18% shortfall versus the coverage target we agreed in the planning cadence. I ran a quick pass on the top-20 deals that can move in the next 30 days and attached a one-page summary plus a MAP (NIM-MAP-v2.xlsx).

Goal: get to a defensible commit for Forecast A by Friday EOD (2028-04-07).

Primary asks (please action by EOD Wed):
- Ben: flag any deals you can reasonably push to Commit this week (stage move + clear next-step) — update HubSpot deal stage + expected close date.
- Marissa: run a quick health check on the five deals we discussed last week (contacts, demo dates, procurement status) and call out any that need leadership touch.
- Neha: confirm whether we should tighten the buffer target from 1.4x to 1.6x for mid-market given current conversion rates, or keep the original target.

Mitigation ideas I want us to consider if coverage stays tight:
- Short-term: target a prioritized outreach blitz to top 6 'late-commit' accounts with tailored pricing concessions and one-week POC windows.
- Medium-term: reallocate two AE SDR hours toward acceleration (deeper CS engagement + exec sponsor intro).
- Contingency: allow a small strategic discount band for deals that clear procurement by next Tuesday and have legal-ready SOW.

Attached: pipeline-buffer-screenshot.png (dashboard snapshot), NIM-MAP-v2.xlsx (deal status + recommended actions).

I'll consolidate responses into a one-pager for Finance and include an ask to extend the forecast lock if we need 48 more hours.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Aditya — useful snapshot. Quick responses:

- Buffer target: keep at 1.4x for now. Moving to 1.6x would force us into overly conservative territory and increase pressure on AE teams (we should revisit if conversion drops again in May).
- Discounting: leadership is OK with a narrow, time-bound concession for procurement-ready deals (max 10% on list, requires legal SOW + PO within 10 business days). Any requests beyond that need a sales leader approval.
- Marissa: please prioritize the five deals in the folder "Q2 Buffer - high tilt" and call out which ones require exec escalation (I'll join those calls).

Aditya — please include a one-line rationale for each deal you mark as 'push to commit' so Finance has visibility into assumptions (customer commitment actions, PO timeline, and risk factors).

Neha Kapoor
Director, Mid-Market Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
